10. Whether tests done in a private laboratory should be given credence is what is required to noticed.
The Government of India has notified standing orders in Standing Order No.1 of 1988 which deals with chemical analysis of seized drugs and would indicate certain procedure.

Clause 1.3 of the said Standing Order reads as follows:
"1.3 An illicit narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances recovered from a person,
